customer_claims_and_requests.text: We read the supplied LED NIR kidney study and want to use the same concept to guide tumor boundary decisions during live surgery. Can we quote its findings as proof that the proposed sensor is ready for that use? We have no new in vivo data and no validation on our own setup. What assessment and next feasibility steps are appropriate?
